#{This algorithm decays accumulated penalty distortion across previously penalized edges to preserve base metric fidelity while applying scaled Guided Local Search penalties to maximum-utility edges of the local optimum.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    # Vectorized penalty decay across edges that have received prior penalties
    decay_alpha = 0.95
    penalized_mask = edge_n_used > 0
    if np.any(penalized_mask):
        # Dissipate accumulated penalties proportionally toward baseline metric fidelity
        updated_edge_distance[penalized_mask] = (
            (1.0 - decay_alpha) * edge_distance[penalized_mask] + 
            decay_alpha * updated_edge_distance[penalized_mask]
        )
    
    # Extract edges forming the current local optimal tour
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Compute Guided Local Search edge utilities
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    penalty = 0.3 * avg_edge
    
    # Identify and symmetrically penalize edges reaching near-maximum utility
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    
    return updated_edge_distance
